title: Study record and reproduction code for a survey of evaluation design and disclosure requirements in reinforcement learning-based route guidance

creators.name: Lee, Donghoun
creators.affiliation: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Sejong University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description: Reproduction material for the survey "Study-Area Boundaries in Reinforcement Learning-Based Route Guidance: A Survey of Evaluation Design and Disclosure Requirements" by Donghoun Lee. The package holds the study record of the 93 reviewed studies, one row per study with the sentence of the research article behind each recorded value; the environments, the planner and the training code of the controlled experiment on the three road networks the manuscript reports, namely a 5x5 grid, Sioux Falls and Anaheim; the exact value-iteration and reachability computations behind the optimal policies and the attainable maximum; the retraining of a released implementation on Anaheim; the screening files of the selection, including the database export records and the exclusion-clause re-execution; and the two gates of the development repository that hold the manuscript and this package in step, one comparing every placed figure with the output of its generator and one recomputing every printed count from the record. MANIFEST.md names the place in the manuscript or the Supplementary that each file supports.
